paite: Migiloute siatna ding in enlah ke'n, akiang ua om ut sam ke'n.
heading: Thugen Sawm-le-kuana
english: Don’t be envious of evil men, neither desire to be with them;

paite: Alungtang un nuaisiahna asin ua, amukte un siatna thu agen uhi.
english: for their hearts plot violence and their lips talk about mischief.

paite: Pilna ziak in inn lam in a-om a; theihsiamna in hihkip in a-om.
heading: Thugen Sawmnihna
english: Through wisdom a house is built; by understanding it is established;

paite: Huan theihna in dantante hihdim in a-om, hauhna manpha leh nuamte tengteng in.
english: by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.

paite: Mipil ahat; ahi, theihna nei mi'n hatna apungsak.
heading: Thugen Sawmnih-le-khatna
english: A wise man has great power. A knowledgeable man increases strength,

paite: Pina pil in na galdouna bawl ding na hi ngal a; huan thuhilhmi tampite ah bitna a-om hi.
english: for by wise guidance you wage your war, and victory is in many advisors.

paite: Mihai a ding in pilna asang lua; kongpi ah akam aka kei hi.
heading: Thugen Sawmnih-le-nihna
english: Wisdom is too high for a fool. He doesn’t open his mouth in the gate.

paite: Kuapeuh hoih lou hih ngaihtuah, mite'n siatna deihmi achi ding uh.
heading: Thugen Sawmnih-le-thumna
english: One who plots to do evil will be called a schemer.

paite: Mihai ngaihtuahna khelhna ahi; huan mite a ding in musitmi kihhuai ahi.
english: The schemes of folly are sin. The mocker is detested by men.

paite: Vangsiat ni a na bahleh, na hatna aneu hi.
heading: Thugen Sawmnih-le-lina
english: If you falter in the time of trouble, your strength is small.

paite: Sihna lam a puakmang a omte suaktasak in, huan thah a om dia mansate nangma'n suaktasak in.
heading: Thugen Sawmnih-le-ngana
english: Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!

paite: Ngai in, hiai ka thei kei uh na chihleh; lungtangte bukpa'n huai angaihtuah kei maw? Na kha kempa'n, huai athei kei maw? Huan michih kiang ah athilhih bang in ape kei ding maw?
english: If you say, “Behold, we didn’t know this,” doesn’t he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul, doesn’t he know it? Shall he not give to every man according to his work?

paite: Ka tapa, khuaizu ne in, ahoih ngal a; huan chep a khum khuaikhak.
heading: Thugen Sawmnih-le-gukna
english: My son, eat honey, for it is good, the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste;

paite: Huchi in pilna na khalam a ding ahi chih na thei ding; na muhleh, huchi in kipahman a-om ding, huan na lametna satkhiak ahi kei ding hi.
english: so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul. If you have found it, then there will be a reward: Your hope will not be cut off.

paite: Aw giloupa, midiktat omna dou ding in tang ke'n; akhawlna mun hihsiatsak ke'n.
heading: Thugen Sawmnih-le-sagihna
english: Don’t lay in wait, wicked man, against the habitation of the righteous. Don’t destroy his resting place;

paite: Midiktat lah sagihvei apuk a, huan athounawn ngal a; himahleh migilou tuahsia zoh in a-om ding hi.
english: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.

paite: Na melma apuk lai in nuamsa ke'n, zoh a a-om lai in na lungtang kipak kei hen.
heading: Thugen Sawmnih-le-giatna
english: Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,

paite: TOUPA'N huai amu kha in, amah akipahpih kei in, huan amah a kipan athangpaihna aheimang kha ding hi.
english: lest Yahweh see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.

paite: Gilou hihte ziak in kilungkhamsak dah in; giloute leng eng sam ke'n.
heading: Thugen Sawmnih-le-kuana
english: Don’t fret yourself because of evildoers, neither be envious of the wicked;

paite: Migilou a ding a kipahman om lou ding ahi ngal a; migilou khawnvak heklup in a-om ding hi.
english: for there will be no reward to the evil man. The lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.

paite: Ka tapa, TOUPA leh kumpipa kihta in; huan akoi mahmah leng thuman lou ke'n.
heading: Thugen Sawmthumna
english: My son, fear Yahweh and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious,

paite: Amau a pan a siatna lah thakhat a om guih ding ahi ngal a; huan amaute a pan tuahsiatna kua ahia thei?
english: for their calamity will rise suddenly. Who knows what destruction may come from them both?

paite: Hiaite leng mipil thugente ahi. Vaihawmna a mite deihsak tuam neih ahoih kei.
heading: Thugen Pilhuai Dangte
english: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judgment is not good.

paite: Kuapeuh migilou kiang a, na diktat hi, chi peuhmah; mite'n amah ahamsiat ding ua, namte'n amah akih ding.
english: He who says to the wicked, “You are righteous,” peoples will curse him, and nations will abhor him—

paite: Himahleh amah salte a ding in kipahna ahi ding, huan atung uah vualzawlna hoih ahong tung ding hi.
english: but it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and a rich blessing will come on them.

paite: Dawnna dik pia mukte mite'n atawp ding uhi.
english: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.

paite: Polam ah na thilhih bawlkhol inla, lou sung ah nang a ding in huai tuh mansa in bawl in; huan huai nung in na inn lam in.
english: Prepare your work outside, and get your fields ready. Afterwards, build your house.

paite: Abul bei in na inveng siatna ding in theihpihmi hi ke'n; huan na mukte in khem ke'n.
english: Don’t be a witness against your neighbor without cause. Don’t deceive with your lips.

paite: Ka tung a ahih bang in amah tung ah leng ka hih ding, chi ke'n; mi anasep bang in ka thuk ding.
english: Don’t say, “I will do to him as he has done to me; I will repay the man according to his work.”

paite: Thadahmi lou kiang ah ka pai a, huan theihsiamna bei mi grephuan kiang ah;
english: I went by the field of the sluggard, by the vineyard of the man void of understanding.

paite: ngai in, ling in akhannelh khin vek a, huai a alouma loulingnei in akhuhta; huan huai a asuang bangte achim khinta hi.
english: Behold, it was all grown over with thorns. Its surface was covered with nettles, and its stone wall was broken down.

paite: Huchih lai in ka en a, hoihtak in ka ngaihtuah a; ka mu a, hilhna ka sangta hi.
english: Then I saw, and considered well. I saw, and received instruction:

paite: Tomkha ihmut zek lai, tomchik lusuk zek, khut khep a tomchik ihmut zek,
english: a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep,

paite: huchibang in suamhatmi bang in na gentheihna ahong pai ding a; huan mi kigalthuam bang in na taksapna hong tung ding hi.
english: so your poverty will come as a robber and your want as an armed man.
